name: Mezra Yalıkavak
dinnerNote: Long tasting menu, 12–14 courses (short tasting menu TRY 7,000)
dinnerNoteTr: Uzun tadım menüsü, 12–14 aşama (kısa tadım menüsü TRY 7,000)

menus.name: Long Tasting Menu
menus.note: 12 to 14 courses, about 2½ to 3 hours; VAT included, drinks extra; a wine pairing is offered but its price isn't published

menus.name: Short Tasting Menu
menus.note: 8 to 10 courses; VAT included, drinks extra

bookingOpens: Online through Check&Place, by phone or on WhatsApp. A prepayment of TRY 2,000 a person confirms the booking, and the rest is paid after the meal.
cancellation: Cancellations made at least 48 hours ahead are refunded in full; later cancellations are not refunded.
dressCode: Smart casual. No beachwear, swimwear, flip-flops or very casual clothes.
children: The tasting menus are not suitable for under-12s. A children's menu (pasta, meatballs, chips) is offered.
duration: About two and a half to three hours for the long tasting menu.
byob: One 750ml bottle a table, with €50 corkage. Wines on the restaurant's list, spirits and house-made drinks may not be brought.
notice: Closed for the season; bookings for 2026 have closed (its booking page, October 2026)
